title: Ashes Into Flowers
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Isaiah came with happy news
For hearts that felt so sad;
He said the Lord would mend them up
And make the weary glad.

[Chorus]
Hand Him the ashes in your hands,
It is the trade He loves;
He gives you beauty for the grey
And joy from up above.

[Verse 2]
He binds up hearts that broke in two
And opens every door;
He wipes the tears from every face
And whispers, "Cry no more."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The oil of joy instead of tears,
A song instead of sighs;
A robe of praise to wear all day
Beneath the bright blue skies.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Then stand up like a sturdy tree
The Lord has planted here,
With roots down deep and branches wide,
And flowers everywhere!

[Chorus]
mood: Lifting music. A slow, warm sway that begins low and grey and opens a little more with every verse, like cupped hands turning over and ashes becoming petals. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeping the sway, a grandmother's warmth close to the ear, nothing underneath but one soft low string. It ends open and glad, like a small tree standing in full sun.
